Prepare first-level designs and files for the selected GLM engines

Source: R/setup_l1_models.R
setup_l1_models.Rd

Prepare first-level designs and files for the selected GLM engines

Usage

setup_l1_models(gpa, l1_model_names = NULL)

Arguments

gpa

A glm_pipeline_arguments object from setup_glm_pipeline.

l1_model_names

Names of the L1 models to prepare. The default selects all L1 models.

Value

The updated gpa. Its l1_model_setup list holds run metadata and setup tables named fsl, afni, and spm. Inspect the table for the engine you selected.

Details

FSL generates a FEAT design per run. AFNI prepares one joint time-series fit per participant and visit. SPM prepares a first-level model per participant and visit by default, with separate SPM sessions for the retained runs. Set gpa$parallel$l1_setup_cores to control parallel setup across participants.
